cacheDiffCard.description: What changed since the previous turn's request - the block that re-created the prompt cache.
cacheDiffCard.diffLargeDefault: The changed text is large, so it isn't diffed by default.
cacheDiffCard.diffStillTooLarge: Still too large to diff here (over {maxLines} lines) - open the Raw tab for the full payload.

cacheDiffCard.loadPreviousCallError: Couldn't load the previous call to diff against.

cacheDiffCard.previousPromptUnavailable: The previous call's prompt isn't available to compare.
cacheDiffCard.statusMessagesEarlierBody: {label} #{index} differs from the previous turn, so everything cached after it is re-processed this turn.
cacheDiffCard.statusMessagesHistoryBody: {removedCount} earlier message(s) are gone this turn (likely history compaction), so the cached message prefix no longer matches.
cacheDiffCard.statusModelBody: This turn used {current} but the previous turn used {previous}. A different model can't reuse the previous prompt cache, so the whole prompt is re-created.
cacheDiffCard.statusPrefixUnchangedBodyAppended: The cached prefix matches the previous turn and {count} new message(s) were appended. A cache miss here points to cache TTL expiry rather than changed content.
cacheDiffCard.statusPrefixUnchangedBodyIdentical: The cached prefix is identical to the previous turn. A cache miss here points to cache TTL expiry rather than changed content.
cacheDiffCard.statusSettingsBody: Only request settings (e.g. temperature) differ from the previous turn. For most providers this alone won't bust the prompt cache.
cacheDiffCard.statusSystemBody: Part of the system prompt changed since the previous turn. Volatile content here - a timestamp, memory, or a per-turn block - re-creates the cache every turn.
cacheDiffCard.statusToolsBody: The tool set or its definitions differ from the previous turn. Tools sit at the front of the cached prefix, so any change here re-creates the cache before it reaches the system prompt and messages.
cacheDiffCard.title: Cache diff
